title: testify.config.json
description: What makes this copy of the bot your own. Every setting is optional; docs/customising.md lists them.

repository.description: Your copy's GitHub repository. The website's source browser shows it, and the bot's Source code buttons open it.

supportServer.description: Where the bot's Support buttons lead, such as a Discord invite. null hides them.

developer.description: Who /bot info names as the developer.

contact.description: An email address or an https:// page.

operator.description: Who runs this copy and how to reach them, shown on the privacy notice and the terms.

defaultPrefix.description: The prefix a server starts with until it picks its own. Up to 8 characters, with no spaces.

greetInviter.description: Sends whoever adds the bot to a server a direct message on how to get started.
